description: This file defines the Table3D class, a Java class that extends a Table class to represent and manipulate a 3D data table for a tuning/logging application. It includes methods for populating, drawing, copying, pasting, interpolating, and comparing 3D tables, as well as handling user interactions and live data highlighting.

classes.name: Table3D
classes.description: Extends Table to handle 3D data visualization and manipulation, including axes, data cells, and various operations such as copying, pasting, interpolating, and comparison.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Populates the 3D table data from a byte array input.

methods.name: copyTable
methods.description: Copies entire table data to clipboard.

methods.name: paste
methods.description: Pastes data from clipboard into table or axes.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Performs vertical and horizontal interpolation on selected data.

methods.name: setCompareValueType
methods.description: Sets the type of comparison (e.g., absolute, relative).

methods.name: setCurrentScale
methods.description: Sets the current scale (unit, range) for axes.

methods.name: getLogParamString
methods.description: Returns a string with logging parameters.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this table is equal to another table object.

calls: DataCell methods (e.g., getBinValue, setRealValue, isSelected, etc.)
